steps.title: Prepare CellROX staining medium
steps.instruction: Warm complete culture medium to 37 °C. Add CellROX Green reagent directly to the medium to obtain a final concentration of 1 µM (for microglia, add enough reagent to make a 2 µM solution when only half the medium is changed, yielding 1 µM final on the cells).

steps.title: Add staining medium to cells
steps.instruction: Add the prepared CellROX‑containing medium to the cultured cells.

steps.title: Incubate stained cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells at 37 °C for 30 minutes, protecting them from light.

steps.title: Replace staining medium
steps.instruction: Remove the staining medium and immediately add fresh, pre‑warmed complete culture medium.

steps.title: Image cells and capture ROS data
steps.instruction: Image the cells immediately using an epifluorescence or confocal microscope with a FITC/GFP‑like channel (excitation ≈ 485 nm, emission ≈ 520 nm) and capture the images to assess ROS levels.
